protocol.validation: Existing five group-stratified Train folds; Test excluded from fitting, scoring and selection
protocol.caveat: EDA and hypotheses were informed by all Train; these are development checks, not independent confirmation; no nested selection or significance claim
protocol.training: keep duplicates only; no resampling; fold-specific balanced class weights; original ordinals one-hot for LR and ordered integers for XGB; nominal derived states one-hot for both
protocol.primary_metric: Average precision; F1 at fixed 0.5 is secondary; paired delta uses identical validation folds
protocol.dedup_sensitivity: Validation only: one occurrence per original 21 features plus target; training remains keep duplicates
